project.description: nn-ios-platform 服务运维 Job。在平台所在的 Jenkins 节点上启动、停止、重启或查看前后端状态。平台路径和端口由 Job 固定，只有登录的 Jenkins 管理员可执行构建。

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ACTION
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: 选择平台服务操作。status 仅检查状态，不会修改服务。

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -eu
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:${PATH:-}" # Jenkins Freestyle 构建结束时不应清理 screen 中的平台后台进程。 export BUILD_ID=dontKillMe export JENKINS_NODE_COOKIE=dontKillMe
PLATFORM_DIR="__NN_IOS_PLATFORM_DIR__" if [ ! -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/start-platform.sh" ]; then echo "ERROR: 平台目录无效。" echo "Expected file: $PLATFORM_DIR/start-platform.sh" exit 2 fi
case "${ACTION:-status}" in start|stop|restart|status) ;; *) echo "ERROR: 不支持的 ACTION: ${ACTION:-}" exit 2 ;; esac
echo "Platform directory: $PLATFORM_DIR" echo "Action: ${ACTION:-status}" cd "$PLATFORM_DIR" bash ./start-platform.sh "${ACTION:-status}"
case "${ACTION:-status}" in start|restart) echo "" echo "Platform status after ${ACTION}:" bash ./start-platform.sh status running ;; stop) echo "" echo "Platform status after stop:" bash ./start-platform.sh status stopped ;; esac
